title: Convert a callback-style Node API to async/await
prompt: This Node project (ES modules) uses error-first callbacks everywhere. Convert it to async/await: every exported function and method in src/ that takes a callback must instead return a Promise and take no callback argument. Where a function passed an Error to its callback it must now reject (throw) with the same message. Keep the same exports from src/index.js and the same results. Convert the tests in test/ to async/await too, and keep `npm test` passing.
